name: loom
description: Ambient capture into Loom's memory plane via Codex lifecycle hooks, the loom-memory / loom-code skills, and loom-code-shunt: bulk shell reads and tree-wide greps in a loom-indexed repo are redirected to the code index.

interface.shortDescription: Shared memory and code index for coding agents, on ClickHouse.
interface.longDescription: Loom gives Codex a memory that outlives the session and is shared with every other agent on the team: decisions, preferences and corrections are captured by lifecycle hooks with no model call, a budgeted primer is loaded at session start, and in a loom-indexed repository the code tools answer structure questions with line-accurate units instead of whole files.
interface.defaultPrompt: What did we decide about this repository last week?
